supporting_ids: s2:Probing the Magnetic Activity of GJ 398 through TESS Flare Detection and uGMRT R
rationale: The papers 'Starspots as the origin of ultrafast drifting radio bursts from an active M dwarf' and 'Probing the Magnetic Activity of GJ 398 through TESS Flare Detection and uGMRT Radio Observations' provide insights into the magnetic activity and radio emissions of ultracool dwarfs, contributing evidence relevant to the question about radio luminosity variations and magnetic field generation.
